### Interface, Inc. to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results Conference Call on August 7, 2026


July 10, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/354928249/files/doc_news/Interface-Inc--to-Host-Second-Quarter-2026-Results-Conference-Call-on-August-7-2026-2026.pdf)


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Interface, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.interface.com%2FUS%2Fen-US.html&esheet=54567480&newsitemid=20260710767998&lan=en-US&anchor=Interface%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=5c542ed2c729f15da2a8b650e6edc04a) (Nasdaq: TILE) announced today that it intends to release its second quarter 2026 results on Friday, August 7, 2026, prior to the open of the market. Interface will host a conference call the morning of Friday, August 7, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time, which will be simultaneously broadcast live over the internet. Laurel M. Hurd, Chief Executive Officer, and Bruce A. Hausmann, Chief Financial Officer, will host the call.


Certain information discussed on the conference call will be available on Interface’s website, at[https://investors.interface.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.interface.com&esheet=54567480&newsitemid=20260710767998&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.interface.com&index=2&md5=04dc8ef52db46d1a6fdc08dab9005925) .


**Call details:**


**Friday, August 7, 2026** 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time, 7:00 a.m. Central Time, 6:00 a.m. Mountain Time, 5:00 a.m. Pacific Time


Listeners may access the conference call live over the Internet at the following address:
[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/506476251](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Furldefense.com%2Fv3%2F__https%3A%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F506476251__%3B%21%21DUclnStaAVz2%21cuSCSYB-NVXl75k9sznj3KELR2t3uXNNoibxfXGZa6WAVu3V8jfIKUx0gbPka2VXVzVfjpj1GNx39ekkblF55jmnooz0hhA%24&esheet=54567480&newsitemid=20260710767998&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F506476251&index=3&md5=05438001d3f1f5979b60749c79c1e5d7)


or through the Company’s website at:
[https://investors.interface.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.interface.com&esheet=54567480&newsitemid=20260710767998&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.interface.com&index=4&md5=fb3ee38784d39297da140fc0acb1f530) .


Please allow at least 15 minutes prior to the call to visit one of these sites and download and install any necessary audio software. An archived version of the conference call will be available at these sites for one year shortly after the call ends.


**About Interface**


Interface is a global flooring and sustainability leader dedicated to rethinking how spaces work for people and the planet. Our portfolio includes Interface® carpet tile and LVT, nora® rubber flooring, and FLOR® premium area rugs. Across every brand, we innovate in a way that combines design, performance, and sustainability—without compromise.


Trusted by architects, designers, and building professionals worldwide, we help bring bold visions to life with solutions that deliver real, measurable impact. Building on more than 30 years of sustainability progress and industry‑first innovation, we remain ‘all in’ on our goal of becoming carbon negative by 2040, without the use of offsets.


Learn more about Interface (NASDAQ: TILE) and our brands at[interface.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finterface.com%2F&esheet=54567480&newsitemid=20260710767998&lan=en-US&anchor=interface.com&index=5&md5=727a45459a8328298c123d5e4d1a4960) and[FLOR.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fflor.com%2F&esheet=54567480&newsitemid=20260710767998&lan=en-US&anchor=FLOR.com&index=6&md5=7f5c526bc41c6af871555d9855e4395d) .
